description: Guide and helpers for a small charity or church that wants a free website with a public Google Calendar: a fill-in swap guide (check the current site, set up Google Sites, embed the calendar, keep links working, move the domain, roll back), Google Calendar embed/add/subscribe links, and reading a calendar ID from a pasted link. No code to run on the church's side.

config_schema.ORG_NAME: string, the organization's name as it should read in the guide
config_schema.NEW_SITE_NAME: string, the name for the new Google Sites site
config_schema.CURRENT_SITE_URL: string, address of the current website
config_schema.DOMAIN: string, the domain name to move, e.g. example.org
config_schema.CALENDAR_ACCOUNT: string, the Google account that owns the calendar
config_schema.CALENDAR_ID: string, the public calendar ID (an email-like address)
config_schema.TIME_ZONE: string, IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York
config_schema.CONTACT_EMAIL: string, who to contact for help
